# Price the service call, not just the part.

> Price an appliance repair service call, then see whether finishing the repair still beats recommending replace — customer cost per remaining year versus what you keep if they decline.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
